records.rationale: Full one-path patch examined. Do not restore the historical skip of task/cgroup priority assignment for sequential zoned WRITE/WRITE_ZEROES. Preserve native bio_set_ioprio and whole native blk-zoned.c. LTS now serializes these writes with per-zone write plugs before request dispatch: first write plugs the zone, following bios queue, completion advances/unplugs the next, and the resubmission branch explicitly identifies its bio as the only in-flight write for that zone. Priority can therefore order independent eligible requests without relying on clearing priorities to serialize one zone. Native conventional-zone and native/emulated append distinctions remain. This is an evidence-based native ordering implementation choice, not a claim BLK_DEV_ZONED is disabled (it is y), nor an untested assertion of runtime correctness on zoned hardware. SDK zoned runtime use is unconfirmed; no new hardware path is enabled.
evidence: SECURITY.md: Block instrumentation lifetime and priority

Native immediate empty-flush completion can free/reuse both objects before original callback; host old-control reproduces modeled invalid arguments. A callback registered after the snapshot begins observing subsequent submissions; restricted hooks cannot unregister. Early error/merge paths remain native without invented post events. Preserve full native cloned-request integrity/crypto checks. Native SCSI lookup validates queue ops and takes get_device reference, so consumer releases with matching put_device; it does not take LLDD module ref and scsi_device_put would additionally drop one. a46ca7 removes the obsolete conditional duplicate export; no new SCSI transport is enabled and SDK SCSI=y/SCSI_VIRTIO disabled.
